text:
It's very sturdy. There is a diagonal bar the keeps the .... Coming out of the box, it appeared well made. Some of the "wood" table top was peeling on the corners but that part is the underside so it doesn't show. It's very sturdy. There is a diagonal bar the keeps the drawers from going all the way through and doubles as a stabilizer. The drawers are interchangeable. It comes with optional wheels but can also be used without wheels. This little cart took about 10 minutes to put together.

The frame is made of coated metal and plastic drawer slides. I love the bins vs drawers.

I recommend this item. 4 stars instead of 5 due to price of item.

product_metadata.title: ECR4Kids 5-Tray Mobile Storage Organizer, Sand with Assorted Colors
features: Organization on the Go — mobile cart for organizing and transporting teaching supplies, office supplies or arts and crafts
Colorful Design — brightly colored trays are ideal for storing toys, office supplies at home, daycares or school classrooms
Built to Last — features cross bars for stability, rounded edges for safety and a top shelf provides additional workspace
Ready to Roll — four locking heavy-duty casters let you wheel your utility cart easily from place to place
Certified and Safe — phthalate-free and GREENGUARD[GOLD] Certified for low chemical emissions into indoor air
Overall Dimensions — 14.9" L x 18.5" W x 26" H, 18 lbs
Drawer Dimensions — large: 14.5" L x 10.5" W x 6" H — small: 14.5" L x 10.5" W x 3" H
Ready to Assemble — Adult assembly required; recommended for ages 15 and up
description: The 5-Tray Mobile Organizer from ECR4Kids is designed to make organizing your life easier and more attractive. The sturdy sand colored rack has rounded edges for safety, casters for mobility, and cross-bars for added strength and durability. The 5 assorted trays, three small and two large, keep art supplies, manipulatives, crafts, toys and more stored safely away in your classroom, playroom, or home. The removable bins slide in and out effortlessly, staying on their tracks. There is additional surface area on top to display items or provide extra storage space. Move the unit from room to room using the four durable casters or replace casters with self-leveling glides to protect floors.
